notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Coercive Recruiter.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, adding an amount of {B} equal to Coercive Recruiter's mana value.
When Coercive Recruiter dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.
